reviews.text:
This is a great store; I find all the necessary products for my cat. The staff is very professional and offers excellent advice with a very pleasant welcome. Even if a product is out of stock, it's ordered and ready for pickup shortly after being notified by phone.
I highly recommend this store.
Alright
Great store
A fantastic welcome! Well done!

Thank you for the consistently perfect welcome and support that goes beyond mere business! My dog's digestive issues were even resolved thanks to your attentive listening, impeccable knowledge, and wonderful care!! Thank you again ✨
Adam is a nice salesman and has a beautiful shop. Greetings from the Netherlands
We discovered this store and received excellent advice from the sales assistants.

Fantastic shop! We've been customers for almost a year and have never been disappointed by the wide selection!
We're always warmly welcomed by the staff, who give excellent advice 💛 …
I received a fantastic welcome from the person at the store. I wanted advice on kibble, and he really helped me out, showing great knowledge of the details. Thank you, I'll be back!

I'm so grateful to the shop! I'm out of kibble, thank you so much for your warm welcome and always smiling advice. It's always a pleasure to shop for my little girl, Shenzy, my Dutch Shepherd 🥰🥰🥰 Today was a lovely surprise for her: two bunny ear plushies, etc. She was so happy, especially since we have so many choices for our furry friends. See you soon! ❤️❤️❤️❤️ Thank you again, I recommend you 1000000%!
A very pleasant welcome and excellent advice specifically for a puppy (games, food, etc.). A strong service culture, including recommending a particular food at my request.

We went to buy a brush for Tchoupi's undercoat, as he sheds a lot during the spring-summer transition (he's an Angora cat)! We were looking for a cheaper alternative to the well-known Furminator (around €30) and we weren't disappointed!!! An advisor suggested a suitable brush for about €11! Thanks to this gentleman, our baby is thriving despite the heatwave (lively, hydrated, and eating well, clean in the litter box), especially since he has respiratory problems! In short, his life has changed, thank you so much... the team is fantastic as always 🙏

A very nice shop for cats and dogs, with a warm welcome.
An attractive store; I'll be back with my dog ​​next time.
A really nice shop with a good selection. There are lots of treats for dogs, lovely, durable products, and the service is very warm and professional.
Excellent welcome and advice. Thank you.
Well located, excellent sales staff. Very professional.

I came to get a muzzle and a tag for my dog, and I want to thank the two people who were at the store. And especially the gentleman who took the time to calmly try on the muzzles with me to find the best size for my timid dog. Thank you so much 🙏🏻 …
I was a bit desperate about cat litter, but I received excellent advice. The aisles are very well organized and the staff is very friendly.
I received a very warm welcome, a wide selection, and excellent advice. I will definitely be back!
Very kind and friendly, well stocked
Adorable saleswoman today ❤️❤️
Great place to shop for your fur baby! Great selection of merchandise. I stop there to get 2 peliches for my dogs. Staff also is very helpful. Highly reccomended.

The shop is very well stocked and well-equipped, and what's great is that the saleswoman who helped me was extremely knowledgeable about dogs. She gave me invaluable advice for my 6-month-old puppy, all very useful and important, and she took the time to help me. That's not always the case, so a big thank you! :)
Very well-stocked shop, really kind and knowledgeable staff! I will definitely be back.
Still as adorable as ever!!
Well stocked pet store just off Lyon's main shopping street, the Rue da la République.

A very pleasant shop.

I mainly go there for Kong dog toys.

Their treat bar is really well-stocked, and I won't hesitate to try it!

However, the cat food is too expensive for my budget (and there wasn't a 10kg bag available).
Large selection of kibble for dogs, cats and other common animals! However, I couldn't find food for my alligator or a harness for my unicorn...

A great find!

Some items are particularly inexpensive (like cat litter), while others are exorbitantly priced (€50 for a harness you can find for €5 elsewhere).

However, there's a wide selection for dogs and cats, and the place is pleasant and well-maintained.

Bonus points for the little donkey in the backpack—it's cute.

Great products and a very friendly welcome.

I'd forgotten my glasses for the dog and I found lots of other great things there. It's a shame they don't offer online shopping.
A lovely shop for your pet
A well-stocked pet store. They have a lot of selection; I bought some treats for my dog ​​there one day when we were passing by.
A store with a wide selection and products you can't find anywhere else!! I go there every week to treat my dog ​​☺️. Not to mention the staff who are always very friendly
Very nice shop, with a wide selection
Managing the queue at the checkout was tricky. We left our purchases behind.

I absolutely love this pet store! They have a huge selection, from food to toys. Sometimes I even get the urge to buy dog ​​supplies… even though I don't have a dog! 😂 But at least I know where to go for when I do get one. The sales assistants are always welcoming and very kind. It's a real pleasure to shop there! …
Shop with fair prices. Friendly staff full of good advice.

Very disappointed with the experience, although the shop is lovely. There was absolutely no flexibility for exchanging a harness size 15 days after purchase, between Christmas and New Year's, because "the store policy is 7 days," indicated in small print at the checkout... and I obviously hadn't noticed!
While it's not mandatory, it should be noted on the receipt, especially since all other stores allow 30 days!
The saleswomen were very friendly and attentive! I highly recommend them 🐶 …
I love this store, which I discovered by chance after adopting my dog ​​in December.

This shop is truly wonderful. The atmosphere is warm and welcoming. You can benefit from the advice of passionate experts! I went there for my ferret and still found what I needed despite the limited selection for small animals.
I recommend this shop to everyone!
The staff were lovely and offered great advice, it was a pleasure! I highly recommend them ☺️☺️
A nice little shop, well-stocked, with friendly and helpful staff. It's a great place to keep the town center alive, and much more welcoming than a big chain store on the outskirts. 💜😻 …

The staff is always very friendly, but this time the store lives up to its name; they never have kibble for my breed of dog, which doesn't seem that rare: a Labrador.

Four times, four failures…
Professional and very friendly

Finally, after a year, I managed to find a place to get my cat's fur trimmed. Although the groomer was quick and my cat, being a cat, was a bit aggressive, his left paw was injured, and the wound is quite serious. However, overall, I was satisfied, and I thank you!
Always a warm welcome, well-priced and always good advice.
